Story

I grew up in the Detroit “Motor City” orbit, where the car in the driveway told a story of status, livelihood, identity.

After going to college in Boston, I returned to Detroit to get started at McCann, working on Buick retail ads. That experience sharpened something I didn’t have language for yet: that I needed a different city, a different industry, a different problem to solve.

McCann sent me to San Francisco to work on the Microsoft Enterprise Software account. There, I dreamt of transferring to New York as I gained formative experience in production, brand, and integrated campaigns for the legendary tech brand.

What followed was over a decade in San Francisco, building growth and brand organizations at innovative companies. Some of those roles involved persuading people to leave their cars behind - a bit of a career plot twist for someone from the Motor City.

I finally made it to New York City after a very strong run in tech and mobility, including leading IDEO’s global brand, and growth, product and brand marketing at Lyft.

I’m now the Chief Marketing Officer at Siegel+Gale, Omnicom’s global brand consultancy, where I create and convey value by embracing creativity and constant change across several industry verticals. My latest passion is using AI to vibe code and discover efficient marketing systems that truly augment human judgment, creative craft and ROI.

Philosophy

Marketing is most powerful when brand clarity, the demand engine, creative, and data are all pulling in the same direction. I use AI to build the systems that make that alignment scalable - without compromising the judgment that makes it meaningful.

On brand

Brand is the constraint that makes AI useful. Without clarity on what you stand for, AI amplifies noise. With it, AI amplifies signal - and the leaders who treat brand as a growth decision tend to be the ones winning.

On teams

The most important hires I’ve made were people better than me in specific areas. The best teams right now are fluent in both human craft and AI leverage - I build for that intersection, protecting creativity while building systems that scale.
